description: This file defines a utility support module for debugging voice wake recognition, including transcript handling, logging, and match summary generation.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRecognitionDebugSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods for debugging and processing voice wake recognition transcripts.

classes.name: TranscriptSummary
classes.description: A structure representing a summary of transcript text, including whether it is text-only and the count of timing segments.

methods.name: shouldLogTranscript
methods.description: Determines whether a transcript should be logged based on its content, previous log state, and timing constraints.

methods.name: textOnlyFallbackMatch
methods.description: Attempts to match a transcript against predefined triggers using a text-only approach, returning a match result if successful.

methods.name: transcriptSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of the transcript including text-only match status and segment timing count.

methods.name: matchSummary
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing a WakeWordGateMatch object, including gap and command length, or indicating no match.
